title: Do The Hard Thing First | A Discipline Short Film
lines: 6:00 a.m. The hardest task is waiting for him.
He wants to scroll. To delay. To hide.
Instead, he does the hard thing first.
The rest of the day feels lighter once the heavy thing is done.
Win the morning, and you win the day.
Procrastination is just fear in a disguise.
Face it early, while you still have the courage.
